note: Written by the evening check (Claude). Own words, verified facts only, each with its source. Display only: no entry or exit rule reads this file.

market.summary: India rose on Friday on IT earnings: Nifty 50 +0.65% to 23,146, with Nifty IT +3.9% after Tech Mahindra's strong quarter, while financials, FMCG and oil & gas lagged and mid/small caps were flat to lower. Abroad the picture is shakier: hot US inflation data on Thursday revived Fed-hike talk and hit AI/chip stocks (Nikkei -4.9%), though US indexes recovered to close higher. For the holdings this is a tailwind for HCLTECH, neutral-to-soft for GROWW (financials and capital-market stocks under pressure) and little direct effect on PREMIERPOL and SEJALLTD. The broad market is still RISK-OFF on the engine's NIFTY 500 check (below the 50 and 200 DMA), so drifts fail more often.

points.text: Nifty 50 closed 23,146.15 (+0.65%), Sensex 74,729.27; Nifty IT was the best sector at +3.9%, Tech Mahindra +8.5%, Wipro +6%; midcaps -0.12%.
Tech Mahindra Q2 FY27: net profit +32.7% YoY to Rs 1,585.6 Cr, revenue +15.6%, deal wins above $1 bn for a fourth straight quarter; brokers rate it Buy.
US 15 Oct: Dow +1.08%, S&P 500 +0.33%, Nasdaq +0.08% after a hotter CPI print made a Fed hike at the next meeting roughly a coin flip; the 10-year yield fell to about 5.09%.
Brent stays expensive near $105-106 a barrel; the rupee gained for a fifth straight session (about 94.95 per dollar).
NSE provisional flows for 16 Oct: FII net buy Rs 1,166 Cr, DII net sell Rs 3,661 Cr; over 5 sessions FIIs are still net sellers of about Rs 8,990 Cr.
SEBI revised the closing auction session and expiry settlement (VWAP of the last 30 minutes), mostly effective 7 Dec 2026; BSE Ltd fell about 2.5%, Angel One about 2.3%.

market.watch: US inflation / Fed-hike pricing and AI-stock volatility; whether FII buying on 16 Oct continues; Brent above $105.

HCLTECH.summary: HCLTECH rose about 1.5% to Rs 1,380 as the whole IT pack rallied on Tech Mahindra's results, and it went ex-dividend today (Rs 12 interim). The call transcript (filed 15 Oct) confirms a solid but not spectacular quarter: record-level bookings and fast AI growth, with guidance narrowed rather than raised and top clients flat. This supports the PEAD drift: the trade is +0.45R, the volume pattern is accumulation, and the stop stays at 1,225.82 until +1R (1,437.78).

points.text: New deal bookings $3.3 bn (+27% YoY, +35% QoQ), the second-highest ever; advanced AI revenue $219 M, +78% YoY.
EBIT margin 18.2% (19% before restructuring costs); FY27 margin guidance 17.5-18.5%; services growth guidance 3-4%.
FY27 revenue guidance narrowed to 2.5-4% in constant currency (low end raised from 1%); Q2 net profit Rs 5,132 Cr (+21.1% YoY) on revenue Rs 35,620 Cr (+11.5%).
Negatives from the call: top 5/10/20 clients not growing, three clients ramping down, software revenue -11.2% YoY, and the new mega deal adds revenue only from next fiscal year.
Nifty IT +3.9% on 16 Oct; HCLTECH about +1.5% to Rs 1,380 and among the week's biggest Nifty 50 gainers with TCS, Infosys and Tech Mahindra.
Record date for the Rs 12 interim dividend was 16 Oct; a notice on a grant of restricted stock units was filed the same morning (not opened).

HCLTECH.watch: A close at or above 1,437.78 (+1R) lets the stop move to cost; watch US AI-stock volatility and Accenture news for the sector.

GROWW.summary: Groww closed at Rs 200.85, flat against the 200.80 entry, after touching 204 (the new box high and entry trigger on the scanner). Brokers are positive after the results (Buy ratings, targets Rs 240-260) and management told analysts the new SEBI closing-auction rules should not hurt its derivatives business. Against that, the engine marks Financial Services as out of favour and US broker peers (Robinhood, Schwab) fell this week. Net: fundamentals support the trade, sector sentiment does not yet; the stop stays at 188.75.

points.text: Jefferies Buy (target Rs 240), Kotak Institutional Equities Buy (Rs 245), Macquarie Outperform (Rs 260) after the Q2 results.
Q2 FY27: net profit about Rs 726 Cr (+54% YoY, -1.2% QoQ), revenue Rs 1,541 Cr (+47% YoY), EBITDA margin 64.5% vs 59.3%; options are now under half of revenue.
On the call: MTF book grows about Rs 600-700 Cr a quarter; market share about 15% in cash and 11% in derivatives; a one-time Rs 10-13 Cr cost from delayed expiry files raised cost to serve.
Management expects the SEBI closing-auction (CAS) change not to hurt derivatives since settlement relies on VWAP; UPI MDR outcome still pending.
SEBI's revised CAS framework (15 Oct circular) takes effect mostly on 7 Dec 2026; on 16 Oct morning Groww was +0.7% while BSE -2.5% and Angel One -2.3%.
Call transcript filed on 16 Oct; on 14 Oct the company filed an application to the exchanges to reclassify some promoter-group holders (PDF not opened).

GROWW.watch: A close above 204 (box high) confirms the breakout; +1R at 212.85. Watch capital-market stocks' reaction to SEBI rule changes.

PREMIERPOL.summary: Nothing material since the 10 Oct results: no new exchange filing, deal or news. The stock closed at Rs 111.51 (+1.8% vs the 109.49 entry, +0.46R) on light volume (0.43x), and the 25-session volume pattern is still accumulation with no distribution days. No change to the trade: stop 105.14, +1R at 113.84.

points.text: Q2 (Sep 2026): net sales Rs 102.55 Cr, PAT Rs 9.81 Cr, EPS Rs 0.93 - record quarterly figures; trailing P/E about 31x.
All-time high of Rs 119.9 on 12 Oct (up 16% that day); the stock has pulled back since, now about 7% below that high.
Last exchange filings are the 10 Oct results and board outcome; no concall has been filed.

PREMIERPOL.watch: A close at or above 113.84 (+1R); a close below 105.14 exits.

SEJALLTD.summary: The results are strong (consolidated revenue +33%, profit +78% YoY), but the price action turned weak today: Rs 870.35, below the 879.95 entry, closing at the day's low on about 2x volume - a distribution day. The company also filed a corrigendum to its STANDALONE Q2 results on 15 Oct; the scanner's figures are consolidated, but what was corrected could not be opened tonight. This is a 1/3 starter until the 19 Oct earnings call; the stop stays at 838.03 and the market cap (about Rs 1,011 Cr) sits just above the Rs 1,000 Cr minimum.

points.text: Q2 FY27 consolidated: net sales Rs 138.09 Cr (+32.8% YoY), net profit Rs 14.28 Cr (+77.8%), OPM 17.3% vs 16.2%; operating cash flow fell 17.5% YoY to Rs 34.88 Cr.
The stock hit the 20% upper circuit at Rs 881.80 on 14 Oct after the results.
Standalone business swung to a small profit of Rs 0.67 Cr; management warned the year-ago comparison is distorted by the April 2025 Glasstech acquisition.
Corrigendum to the standalone results for the quarter and half year ended 30 Sep 2026 filed on 15 Oct (contents not verified tonight).
Earnings call scheduled for 19 Oct 2026 at 3:30 pm.

SEJALLTD.watch: 19 Oct 3:30 pm earnings call decides whether to add the remaining 2/3; read the corrigendum; a close below 838.03 exits.
